description: She wears a floor-length muted teal gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad gold cloud-like and floral borders decorate the neckline, shoulders, sleeve ends and skirt front, and a cream-gold brocade panel fills the center skirt opening. A gold medallion belt with dark centered plaques has long hanging medallion and tassel ornaments. A cream wrap with teal-and-gold embroidered edging rests around her arms. Matching gold drop earrings and a round pendant necklace with teal drops complete the outfit. Dark embroidered closed shoes are visible below the hem.
